fieldValues.title: 9. The boards
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Five GitHub Projects: #5 'SRS' (1,347 items), #6 'SemanticOps' (552), #4 'MuDemocracy' (37), #3 'mu democracy roadmap' (38) and #2 'SemOps Agent Workflow' (0). The handbook says clerk board sync writes #6 hourly and that only this tool writes Projects v2 fields. srs-rust documents a gh-project tool for #5. Stories and epics live in semanticops.com; implementation issues in any governed repo.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Two projects are each described as 'the board'.
- #2 is empty; #3 and #4 are small and may be unused.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Which projects can be archived without losing anything an agent reads?
